environment.description: ASP.NET Core 6.0 application deployed on Azure App Service (Basic tier B1) behind default Azure load balancer. No WAF or API Management gateway configured. The application is exposed directly via the App Service default domain (*.azurewebsites.net). BinaryFormatter is enabled via the runtime configuration flag System.Runtime.Serialization.EnableUnsafeBinaryFormatterSerialization=true in runtimeconfig.json. No request filtering middleware is configured in the application pipeline.
